selection_rule: Recreate the pinned archived public selection, then select 512 group-unique licensed rows in source order from the held-out test split after excluding every group in the checksum-pinned prior training, calibration, test, OOD, and first independent comparison selections. Drop candidate-overlength prompts without truncation and score both models on exactly the same remaining IDs.
evaluation_rule: No candidate training, calibration, or hyperparameter tuning on these rows. Use the candidate's already-fitted calibration temperature and the released model's frozen logits. Compare overall and per-kind top-1, NLL, Brier, and Score ranked probability score.
limitations: The candidate evaluation is frozen before candidate scoring, but the protocol was created after the released baseline was scored.
This compares with released Open-Jev, not proprietary TypeSafe Jev; it is not Jev-parity evidence.
The public synthetic decisions do not establish desktop task success, safe execution, or model authority.
